item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Your first week is full Premium. Cloud transcription and AI Styles for seven days after you sign in. No card.
  • Free gives more. 1000 words a day, your full history, and custom vocabulary — all three used to be limited or Premium-only.
  • AI Styles keep your words. They no longer swap a word for a synonym, drop the small words that change what a sentence claims, or "correct" product names, commands and technical terms into ordinary words that resemble them.
  • Your custom vocabulary now reaches styling too, so spellings you added on purpose survive.
  • History is kept forever by default.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Sign-in now shows kazhy.app. The macOS dialog that appears when you sign in with Google or Apple used to name a long, random-looking database address — the kind of thing you should not approve. It now names auth.kazhy.app.

Sign-in itself is unchanged and still takes one click.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description: Fixes a crash on launch. 1.0.0 quit immediately on startup instead of opening — if nothing happened when you opened Kazhy, this release fixes it. Re-download and replace the app; no settings are lost.
